title: Orphan Claim — Convert to Regular (one-click prefill, full walkthrough)
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — banner sets the active conversion to skeleton CLM-2024-SKEL-001 and prefills every wizard step
Land on /fnol/search — info banner reads 'Converting from CLM-2024-SKEL-001'; Client name + Policy number + Date of loss already filled
Click Search → matching policy POL-2024-021 (Jonas Kaufmann) shows in the table
Land on /fnol/loss-information — date / time / cause / damage / description / loss location ALREADY prefilled. Review, click Next.
Walk Entities & Damages → Parties → Reserves → Summary; nothing else is required
Click Confirm on Summary — the skeleton is matched to the new regular claim
Fallback: 'Cancel conversion' on the search banner clears all prefilled state and drops back to a blank /fnol/search

acceptanceCriteria.statement: One Apply prefills every wizard step; user navigates through Search → Loss → … → Summary themselves
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Applying this AC stages a complete Convert-to-Regular demo:
- Active skeleton: **CLM-2024-SKEL-001** (Jonas Kaufmann, Fire at Munich warehouse)
- `/fnol/search` info banner: **'Converting from CLM-2024-SKEL-001'**
- Search form prefilled: **Client name = Jonas Kaufmann**, **Policy number = POL-2024-021**, **Date of loss = 04-05-2024** — user just clicks Search
- `/fnol/loss-information` prefilled: occurrence + notification dates / times, **Cause = Fire**, **Damage = Material damage**, description = 'Fire at Munich warehouse', loss location = 'Munich Warehouse, Industriestraße 12, 80807 Munich, Germany'
- Downstream steps (Entities & Damages / Parties / Reserves / Summary) inherit the prefilled FNOL state and only need a Next click each
- The user is never skipped past a step — they walk it themselves with prepared context
- 'Cancel conversion' on the search banner clears state cleanly
